subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub support declared MIT skill licenses for published skills, or continue enforcing a uniform MIT-0 publication contract?
rationale: Current main intentionally encodes MIT-0 across schema, publish consent, docs, UI, and CLI, while the reporter and the linked PR ask for a different public licensing model.

options.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 support
options.body: Review and land the linked candidate after real behavior proof and an operator-safe backfill plan show existing MIT-declared versions will be repaired.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
options.body: Keep the current platform policy, update any confusing copy if needed, and close the linked candidate as conflicting with product direction.

options.title: Scope future publishes first
options.body: Allow declared MIT for new imports/publishes while tracking existing-version backfill as a separate migration decision.

recommendation.title: Approve mixed MIT/MIT-0 support
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked candidate after real behavior proof and an operator-safe backfill plan show existing MIT-declared versions will be repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is tied to both the MIT-0 enforcement commit and the prior product-direction comment closing heterogeneous license metadata.
